title: I keep dreaming about the same house
content: It's a big abandoned house that looks more modern than old. It's made of dark wood and it looks unpainted. Kind of like a modern log cabin style Part of the upper floor is extended out from the first floor and held up by beams. There's a swimming pool outside but it's all green and murky There's a hidden passage near the basement stairs There's also a big storage room somewhere. It's filled with stuff and an angry ghost guards it Last night I found out it was connected to some sort of church too. I think the church acted like a meeting place for other people in other houses. Maybe it's all part of some system I think that's all I remember
